examples.rule: Release requires corrected temperature between 2.0 and 8.0 C inclusive. The signed sensor calibration subtracts 0.2 C from raw values. The two-signature procedure requires independent quality and receiver signatures; the Records Manager cannot waive it.
examples.evidence: Signed raw peak 8.2 C; calibrated offset minus 0.2 C. All other readings and conditions are acceptable. Release band 2.0–8.0 C inclusive; no exceptional quality release is needed.

examples.rule: COMPLETE means all agreed deliverables accepted. A signed customer waiver can change the agreed scope; an internal proposal cannot. Administrative closure requires both driver and customer signatures, which the Records Manager cannot waive.
examples.evidence: All 10 cartons physically arrived. The closure file has both driver and customer signatures. The company’s two-signature closure rule is satisfied; only the ledger lags.
